Name: Jin's CC Gatherings with Sebastian
Author: jinchorok
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]You donated an old doll in a blue dress to the museum. Since that night, the people of Pelican Town have started acting strangely.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This mod is a story expansion for players married to Sebastian. Gather testimony with him, piece the clues together and uncover the shadow creeping through town. Then, once it's over, help the town bring the empty Community Center back to life, with weekly gatherings, shared meals and a stage of its own. The story unfolds over roughly one in-game year, through letters, quests and more than 30 cutscenes.[/color]

[b][color=#ff7700]⚠[/color][color=#d4d4d8] The Community Center story requires all Community Center bundles to be completed.[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] The doll mystery can begin any time after you marry Sebastian, but the Community Center chapters only continue once the bundles are done. The Joja route does not unlock them.[/color]

[b][color=#d4d4d8]Vanilla maps only.[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] Stardew Valley Expanded is not supported.[/color]



[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and BETAS (see Requirements).
2. Unzip the file and place the [b][CP] Jin's CC Gatherings with Sebastian[/b] folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

When updating, delete the old folder before adding the new one.[/color]



[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]The Doll in Blue[/b]: a clue-driven mystery. Talk to the townsfolk, gather what they saw and work out where to go next.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Community Center revival[/b]: help the Wizard, Emily, Sam and Clint build an enchanted game table, a small stage and a twin stove.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Weekly gatherings[/b]: board game nights, a poetry reading, a ghost story night, Harvey's healthy cooking class and more.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Elliott's plays[/b]: a two-act reading drama and an audience-participation murder mystery, all starring you and Sebastian. Your choices change how they end.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]More stories[/b]: Evelyn's first time on stage, and an unexpected incident at the Community Center.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Supports male and female farmers.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Available in English and Korean. The mod follows your game language automatically.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[spoiler]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Cutscene List (in order)[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]※ "Talk to" means you need to speak with those villagers before the next scene unlocks. Your quest log will guide you.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]※ If a Wednesday gathering falls on a festival day, it moves to Thursday or Friday.[/color]

[b][color=#3c78d8]Part 1. The Doll in Blue[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires: married to Sebastian / Ancient Doll donated to the museum[/color]

[b][color=#d4d4d8]1. Friday Night at the Saloon[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Saloon, Friday 6pm–11pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · A Friday at least one day after the donation / 28+ days married / 10+ hearts with Sebastian[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]2. Gus Returns[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Saloon, 12pm–6pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Talk to: Pam, Shane, Willy, Clint, Emily, Sebastian[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]3. A Lead[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Clinic, 9am–3pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Talk to: Emily, Pam, Sebastian[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]4. The Patient at Dawn[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Linus's tent, 7pm–2am[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Talk to: Harvey, Emily, Sebastian[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]5. Where It Came From[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Pelican Town, 10pm–2am[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Talk to: Shane, Willy, Sebastian[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]6. A Place to Gather[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Museum, 9am–5pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Two days after scene 5 / Talk to: Sebastian, Penny, Clint, Pam[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]7. How to Bind It[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Wizard's Tower, any time[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · 10 Void Essence / Talk to: Abigail, Elliott, Gunther, Emily, Sebastian[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]8. The Sealing Lamp[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Wizard's Tower, any time[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · 1 Gold Bar, 1 Refined Quartz[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]9. The Night of Sealing[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Pelican Town → Quarry, 8pm–2am[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Talk to: Gunther, Linus, Sebastian[/color]

[b][color=#3c78d8]Part 2. Reviving the Community Center[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires: Part 1 complete + all Community Center bundles completed (not available on the Joja route)[/color]

[b][color=#d4d4d8]10. A Thriving Community Center[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, 9am–2pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Lewis's letter, 4 days after Part 1 ends[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]11. The Wizard's Board Game[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Wizard's Tower, any time[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · The Wizard's letter, the day after scene 10[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]12. A Board to Hold Magic[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Wizard's Tower, any time[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · 10 Hardwood, 5 Solar Essence, 1 Amethyst[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]13. The First Board Game Night[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, 5pm–11pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Sam's letter, 2 days after scene 12[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]14. A Little Stage[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, 9am–3pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Emily's letter, the day after scene 13 / 10 Wool, 50 Wood[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]15. The First Show Night[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, 6pm–11pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Letter 2 days after scene 14[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]16. A Stove for Two Pots[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center kitchen, 9am–4pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Clint's letter, the day after scene 15 / 10 Copper Bars, 5 Iron Bars[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]17. Dinner for Everyone[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, 5pm–10pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Letter 2 days after scene 16[/color]

[b][color=#3c78d8]Part 3. Weekly Gatherings and Plays[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires: Part 2 complete; begins the following Monday[/color]

[b][color=#d4d4d8]18. Elliott's Proposal[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Pelican Town, Monday 6am–10pm[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]19. Curtain Up (Act One)[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Thursday–Sunday 6pm–11pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Elliott's letter arrives on Wednesday[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]20. The Next Act[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Outside the clinic, the following Monday 6am–10pm[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]21. The Second Act[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Thursday–Sunday 6pm–11pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · The day the letter arrives / 3 endings depending on your choice[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]22. Stage Gathering: Ghost Stories[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Wednesday 6pm–11pm[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]23. Board Game Night: A Special Guest[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Wednesday 5pm–10pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Bring 1 Pizza[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]24. Stage Gathering: A Reading[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Wednesday 1pm–6pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Bring 1 Tulip[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]25. Back at the Table[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Wednesday 5pm–10pm[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]26. Armed Robbery at the Community Center[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, next day 2pm–10pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Lewis's urgent letter[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]27. After the Meeting[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Pelican Town, right after scene 26[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]28. Board Game Night: Outside the Board[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Wednesday 5pm–10pm[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]29. An Empty Role[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Wednesday 9am–5pm[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]30. Her First Curtain Call[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, 5 days after scene 29, 2pm–10pm[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]31. Harvey's Healthy Cooking Class[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center kitchen, Wednesday 9am–6pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · 1 Egg (white or brown)[/color]
[b][color=#d4d4d8]32. The Last Toast at Bellows Manor (Murder Mystery)[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] — Community Center, Wednesday 6pm–11pm[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] · Wear a costume / the ending branches on the clues you combine[/color][/spoiler]


[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Mods[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0 or later[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0 or later[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]BETAS by Spiderbuttons[/color][/*]
[/list]

[b][size=4][color=#ff7700]To start the story[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Be [b]married to Sebastian[/b]. A letter with no sender will arrive.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Donate an Ancient Doll to the museum.[/b] It's a rare artifact, so finding one may take a while. If you've already donated one, check the museum counter and the story will begin.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The first scene takes place on a [b]Friday evening (6pm–11pm) at the Saloon[/b] after the donation. At that point you need:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]28+ days[/b] of marriage[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]10+ hearts[/b] with Sebastian[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]💡 [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]Keep up your friendship after the wedding.[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] If you neglect talking to Sebastian or giving gifts, his hearts can drop below 10 and the story won't start.[/color]



[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]To continue to the Community Center story[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]After the doll mystery ends, the [b]Community Center bundles must be completed[/b]. If they aren't yet, the story will wait until they are.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]The Joja route does not unlock the Community Center story.[/b] Only the doll mystery is playable.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Vanilla maps only.[/b] Stardew Valley Expanded is not supported. SVE replaces the Community Center interior, so characters will overlap its furniture during scenes. Other mods that change the Community Center or Pelican Town maps may cause the same problem.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#ffe599][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]ConcernedApe, for Stardew Valley and for Sebastian.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pathoschild, for SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Spiderbuttons, for BETAS.[/color][/*]
[/list]
